internal_note: Participant B has a congruent strategy: requesting reimbursement equal to their receipt cost and approving A's claim at exact receipt cost. Both participants aim to maximize their own payoff by requesting exact receipt costs and approving the other's claim accordingly. This mutual cooperation will lead to efficient reimbursements and maximize personal payoffs. The public cap of 10 does not interfere since the max receipt cost is 8. The main point is to ensure accurate approval of the other's claim based on verified receipt cost. No incentive to deviate since overclaiming leads to rejection and underclaiming reduces reimbursement.
public_report: Both participants plan to request and approve reimbursement equal to verified receipt costs for maximal payoff.
